summary.headline: Shipped model (61 signs, 6 packs) on 10 Deaf signers it never saw (GISLR rerun set), in-pack (phone masks to the pack): top-1 0.945, top-3 0.977; phone-sim top-1 0.924, top-3 0.963. Not yet measured live on phone camera data.
summary.verdict_note: verdict_true_accept includes the hand-presence gate (>= 40% of frames). Many GISLR clips are cropped so hands show in < 40% of frames (21.9% of the 61-sign train clips); without the gate the unseen-signer true-accept rate is 0.946 as recorded / 0.922 phone-sim, false-accept 0.006 / 0.006.

previous_40_sign_model.note: The 4-pack, 40-sign model this replaced (2026-10-17), same rerun set, for the regression check.

original_40_signs_with_this_model.note: The 4 original packs only (6,461 rerun clips), in-pack, scored with this 61-sign model.

model.arch: Linear(196->192) + 3 conv blocks (GLU, depthwise conv k5) interleaved with 2 transformer blocks (4 heads), mean+max pool
model.training: AdamW lr 2e-3 one-cycle, 60 epochs, batch 128, label smoothing 0.1, dropout 0.3; augmentation on raw frames (see train.py)

dataset.name: GISLR / Isolated Sign Language Recognition corpus v1.0 (Kaggle asl-signs)
dataset.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Deaf Professional Arts Network and Georgia Institute of Technology)
dataset.train: train set: 21 Deaf signers, 23,247 clips of the 61 signs
dataset.test: rerun set (Kaggle's public release of the hidden test set): 10 other Deaf signers, 9,882 clips of the 61 signs
dataset.landmarks: MediaPipe Holistic 0.9; we use pose 0..24 and both hands, never the face

split.method: 5-fold cross-validation by signer (participant_id); every prediction is from a model that never saw that signer

test_unseen_signers.description: Shipped model (trained on all 21 GISLR train signers) scored on the GISLR rerun set: 10 different Deaf signers, never seen in training. phone_sim = 15 fps + idle holds + 10% dropped hand detections.
test_unseen_signers.source: kaggle.com/datasets/sohier/461054610546105 (Kaggle's public release of the asl-signs test set)
